heroHeadline: High Court Finds Police Chief Kanja in Contempt Over Anniversary Roadblocks, Sentencing Set for Sept 28
heroSubtitle: Justice Patricia Nyaundi ruled September 17 that Inspector General Douglas Kanja defied a standing court order requiring advance notice before barricading Nairobi roads, following the CBD lockdown that sealed the capital during June 25 anniversary protests; Kanja must appear September 28 for mitigation and sentencing, while IPOA and DCI still have not named any officer in journalist Alex Kiprotich's September 1 abduction
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
